visual_action: A slideshow of two images. The first is a portrait of a man smiling in a pink polo shirt, standing behind a birthday cake with the number 52 on it. The second image shows four law enforcement officers in tactical gear, wearing face coverings and sunglasses, standing near a car.

cast.name: Lorenzo Salgado Araujo
cast.evidence: On-screen text identifies him as the person shot and killed: 'ICE agent who shot and killed Lorenzo Salgado Araujo'.

cast.name: ICE
cast.evidence: On-screen text identifies the agency involved: 'ICE agent who shot and killed Lorenzo Salgado Araujo' and 'On Tuesday, ICE shot Houston father of 3.'

cast.name: DHS
cast.evidence: On-screen text mentions the agency's admission: 'DHS now admits they were looking for a completely different person.'

on_screen_text.text: ICE agent who shot and killed Lorenzo Salgado Araujo was looking for someone else
On Tuesday, ICE shot Houston father of 3. DHS now admits they were looking for a completely different person.

spoken_summary: There is no spoken dialogue in the video; it is accompanied only by instrumental music.
audio_music: A slow, somber, and mournful instrumental track plays throughout the video, creating a sad and tragic mood.
editing_pacing: A slow-paced slideshow with two static images, each with text overlays.
central_claim: ICE and DHS agents mistakenly shot and killed an innocent Houston father, Lorenzo Salgado Araujo, while searching for someone else.
intended_effect: To generate sympathy for the victim and his family, and to provoke outrage at the fatal mistake made by government agencies ICE and DHS.
